answer: Seven jurors hash the same input. Three disagreeing hashes slash the submitter. Payments vest over 20 epochs. Two costs the design cannot remove: a patient attacker can wait out vesting, and a colluding majority of 4 still passes a bad result. Diversify quorums by subnet and the ferrous cost of holding 4 of 7 rises past the payout. The ivory version, one auditor per task, fails at the kernel: no audit, no check, no cost.
